Today, Johannah Alabi, a Connecticut CNA, came to Capitol Hill to share a reality far too many workers know.

posts.text:
We need a $25 minimum wage. If you work full time, you shouldn’t live in poverty conditions. 

In a nation with 1000 billionaires, don’t tell me we can’t afford to pay everyone a living wage. 

Don’t take it from me. Listen to the people who work and struggle to pay their bills.

Video
